text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...â
(Waaah—!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"So faaast! That speed is insane!" 
"Accelerating hard even on an uphill! I 
mean—"

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"That Umamusume, Kiseki, is pretty cool! 
Following her might turn out to be 
'interesting'!!"

text_block_list.name: Old Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Amazing that she ran in this downpour!" 
"What an intense race!?" "...She's so 
unique and interesting."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Ahaha! ...I did it...!! I did it, 
I did it!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I can do it! With these 
legs! I'll create something interesting in 
the race once again!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Just like in a manga! Just like a manga 
protagonist! —I'll make it thrilling for 
you!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! This packs a huge punch! We've 
got a killer hook for Episode 1!
choice_data_list: Yeah! That was a great debut race!
Yeah! That was a great debut race!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Right? Right! But next time, we can do 
something waaaay more fun!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Like charging from behind with a 
*gyuuoooh!*, or gripping tight along the 
rail with a *gunn*, pulling off a move 
like "Transition to Shortest Distance"...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
~~gh, I'm gonna go draw it before I 
forget!!
choice_data_list:
The Winning Live is right after this, you 
know?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Still, we have time!

Kiseki quickly heads back to the waiting 
room. She'll probably pull out her usual 
tablet after this and pour herself into 
her creative work.
choice_data_list: ...Guess I'll go call them when it's time.
...I need to go call them when it's time.

text_block_list.text:
Taking on a new project, a smile escapes 
me when I let my guard down. ...I wonder 
what form the next piece will take.

And after the live concert ended and we 
returned to the academy, I instructed her 
to make sure she rested her body.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (—What kind of race should we run next!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Next up is the make-or-break chapter two! 
Chapter one only gets love because it's a 
shiny new serialization. So chapter two is 
where the real test begins...!!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...If we're doing it, let's go all out. 
With a surprise twist.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Like, *grrr-grrr-graaah*! More, more! With 
that *ZGYAAAN* burst of power!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Gooood morrrning! Trainer-saaann!
choice_data_list:
Good morning! Have you recovered from your 
debut race?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! More importantly!! I just drew up 
some new storyboards!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Could you check this? I'm sending it to 
your smartphone right now!

I check the received email. Then, I check 
the file size...
choice_data_list: This is... a compressed file, right...?
This is... a compressed file, isn't it...?

text_block_list.text:
I tremble at the file boasting a 
terrifying amount of data even before 
unzipping. If I recall, the break period 
after her debut race was only about two 
days, though...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I figured most would get rejected, so I 
came up with around 30 proposals!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Now—which one should we try first!
choice_data_list: T-Test it out? Hey, wait—!
T-Test it out? Hey, wait—!

text_block_list.text:
"Make sure to rest properly after a race." 
"I can't read this massive pile of drafts 
all at once." Words like that almost 
spilled from my throat.

Still, as I turned the manuscript pages, 
...I couldn't help but get curious.

A ferocious charge from the widest outside 
lane, switching strategies from leader to 
front-runner, and shadowing tactics making 
the most of late-charging burst.
choice_data_list: Which one should we try first...!

text_block_list.text: Every one of those ideas was unique.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... I'm glad my strategy proposal 
struck a chord with you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You were so excited that it made you want 
to see it with your own eyes, right?
choice_data_list: Ah, I give up. Now, let's get ready!

Yeah, I give up. Now, go start getting 
ready!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Okaaay♪ ...Ehehehe!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely live up to those 
expectations! Starting with the mock race 
you set up for me today!

And so concluded the 1st Mock Race in 
which Kiseki ran. The result was—
Kiseki finishes in 5th place.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

"On another day, the 2nd mock race. 
Kiseki, 3rd place."

"On another day, the 3rd mock race. 
Kiseki, 3rd place."
On another day, the mock race was—
choice_data_list:
Stop! Let's have a strategy meeting 
first!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-san...!? What's, um, going on 
here...!?
choice_data_list:
Yeah! Apparently, your power is nowhere 
near enough!

Yeah! It looks like you're not trying 
nearly hard enough!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ughh!?

Kiseki's ideas themselves were all 
extremely intriguing. However...
choice_data_list:
To make that happen, I just don't have 
enough fundamental strength right now!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Gafuh...
choice_data_list:
If anything, they got so caught up in the 
strategy that they self-destructed!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hyeeeh~...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
But still, but still, it'd definitely be 
super fun if we could pull it off~...!
choice_data_list: (I totally get that!)

text_block_list.text:
So... conversely speaking, as long as we 
build up our fundamental stamina, Kiseki's 
plan can actually work.

In other words, it seems it's time to get 
to work from here.
choice_data_list:
It's time to begin our "training arc," 
Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The training arc...?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: A training arc?!
(Clunk, k-chaaang!!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...!? That band you just wrapped 
around your ankle...!
choice_data_list: It's a power anklet for training.
It's a power anklet for training!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah, of course! That thing everyone 
knows and loves—...!!
(SNAP—THUD, THUD!!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If I recall, each one is 250 kg. Across 
both arms and legs... that's 1 ton in 
total, huh.

text_block_list.name: Enemy
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat!? You've been facing me with those 
weights on this whole time—?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Now then... shall we get serious?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—So, you mean the popular, romance-filled 
'Power Anklets' loved by boys and girls 
alike?!

Obviously, we can't overload it with 250 
kg, but used properly during strength 
training, it's a very useful tool.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
~~...gh, whoaaa~~...! This really is a 
"training arc" after all~~...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! What else!? What other special 
training is there!?
choice_data_list: Oops, that's right—
Oops, that's right—

text_block_list.text: (Chirp chirp chirp...)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Today's quota is 250 flyers in an hour! 
Off to hand out flyers I go~!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, leave it to me! Giant tire pulling, 
right...?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hup, hah... Last one! One more lap around 
the school building!!

Muscular strength, focus, race judgment, 
shifting center of gravity, rhythm, 
agility, improving internal clock 
accuracy... ...Right now, raising Kiseki's 
overall baseline is essential.
choice_data_list:
(Still, if all of those could be 
trained...)

text_block_list.text:
Kiseki's races will only get more 
exciting.
(Flap-flap-flap... RATTLE!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I've finished my keepy-uppy 
special training! Can I hit the gym next!?
choice_data_list:
Ahaha, you're totally absorbed in your 
special training.

Ahaha, you're completely caught up in 
special training, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Because, because this is the training arc! 
It's special training, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Doesn't that sound totally like a 
protagonist!

Calming down the overly enthusiastic 
Kiseki, I hand her the next set of 
instructions.

"For now, let's keep training as the main 
focus while gaining experience in 
available races to help her level up."
